paite: Pathian thou in amelmate delhzak hen; amah hote leng ama ah taikek uhen.
heading: David phatna La / Nam Vualzawlna La
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

paite: Meikhu mutmang a a-om bang in, amaute mutmang in; meilum a khuainun azul bang in migilou-saloute Pathian ma ah mangthang uhen.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

paite: Midiktatte bel kipaktak in om uhenla; Pathian ma ah nuam uhenla; ahi, kipaktak in nuam uhen.
english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

paite: Pathian pahtawi in la sa unla, amin phat in la sa un; kangtalai a gamdaite paisuakna ding in lamlian ding sungvum unla, amin TOUPA ahi; ama ah nuam un.
english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

paite: Pathian a-omna siangthou a om, pabeite Pa leh meithaite ngaihtuahpa ahi.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

paite: Pathian in mi tangkhatte inkuan ah apangsak a, mihentate apikhia a, vangphatna ah apilut hi; helhatte zaw gamkeu ah a-om uhi.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

paite: Pathian aw, na mite makai a na hong pawt a, gamdai a na paisuak lai in, Selah
english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

paite: lei aling dupdup a, vante leng Pathian ma ah atakkhia a; Sinai Tang hilhial leng Pathian ma ah, Israel' Pathian ma ah, aling dupdup hi.
english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

paite: Pathian aw, nang vuah tampi na zusak a, na gouluah ding, abah lai in, na hihkip hi.
english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

paite: Na mi omkhawmte'n huai ah panmun akhoh ua; Pathian aw, nang na hoihna in gentheite a ding inn na bawlsak hi.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

paite: Toupa'n thu apia, tanchin genmi numeite pawl lianpi ahi uhi.
english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

paite: Sepaihte kumpipate ataikek ua, inn ngaknu'n gallak sum ahawm hi.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

paite: Vakhu kha dangka-eng a luan a, akha mong leng dangka-eng te selsel a luan bang in, belam huang kal bang ah om mah le uh.
english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

paite: Bangkim hihthei in huai akumpipate ahihzak lai, Zalmon tang a vukzuk lai bang ahi hi.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

paite: Pathian tang Bashan tang ahi a; Bashan tang tuh tang sangpi ahi.
english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

paite: Tang sangtakte aw, Pathian in a-omna ding a atang deih, bangziak a haza a en. Ahi, TOUPA huai ah tangtawn in a-om nilouh ding ahi.
english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

paite: Pathian kangtalai singnih ahi a, asang a sang tampi ahi; TOUPA tuh Sinai Tang a om bang in, huai lak ah mun siangthou ah a-omta hi.
english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

paite: Nang tunglam ah na paitou a, matte sal in na pi a; mihingte a pan thilpiakte na mu a, ahi, helhatte a pan in leng; akiang ua TOUPA Pathian a- omtheihna ding in.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

paite: TOUPA ka puak uh niteng a hon puaksakpa, hon hondampa Pathian phat in om hen. Selah
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

paite: Ei Pathian zaw hotdamna Pathian ahi; TOUPA Pathian ah sihna a pan suahtakna a-om hi.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in amah melmate lu asat phel ding a, gitlouhna a pai zelte lu sam phatak.
english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Bashan gam a kipan in ka pi nawn ding a tuipi nuai thuktak a pan ka pi nawn ding.
english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

paite: Na khe sisan a na diah theih a, na ui leite'n na doute lak a tan aneihtheihna ding in," achi a.
english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

paite: Pathian aw, na pailaite amu ua, i Pathian i kumpipa mun siangthou a apai lai
english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

paite: nungak khuang bengte lak ah, lasa pawlte apai masa ua, tumging tum pawl in azui uhi.
english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

paite: Kikhopnate ah Pathian phat un, Israel tui nak a pawtte aw, TOUPA phat un.
english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

paite: Huai ah nautum Benjamin avaihawmpa un a-om chiuchiau, Judah miliante leh a-upate uh, Zebulun miliante, Naphtali miliante toh.
english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

paite: Na Pathian in na thilhihtheihna apia a; Pathian aw, kou ding a thil na hon hihsak hihhat in.
english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

paite: Jerusalem a na tempul ziak in Kumpipate'n kipahmante ahon puak ding uhi.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

paite: Dangkate sikden in sialluang lak a gamsahangte taihilh in; bawngtal tampi, michih bawngnoute toh kidou ut mi khempeuh ahihzakta hi.
english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan in miliante ahong pawt ding ua; Ethiopiate akhut uh Pathian lam a zak ding in akintat ding uh.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

paite: Leitung gamte aw, Pathian pahtawi in la sa unla; aw, TOUPA phat in la sa un. Selah
english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—

paite: Vante van nidanglai a omte tung a tuangpa mah. Ngai in, a-aw asuah a, A-aw thupitak mahmah ahi.
english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

paite: Pathian kiang ah hatna pia un; athupina Israelte tung ah a-om a, ahatna vandumte ah a-om hi.
english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

paite: Pathian aw, na mun siangthou a kipan in na kihtakhuai ahi. Amah Israel' Pathian ngei in amite kiang ah hatna leh thilhihtheihna apia hi. Pathian phat in om hen.
english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
